title: quercus brantii subsp. persica
intro: Quercus brantii subsp. persica, commonly known as Persian oak, is a subspecies of deciduous tree native to the Middle East. The Persian oak has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, providing numerous health benefits such as improving heart health, reducing inflammation, and boosting the immune system. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These compounds may also exhibit anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects, making the Persian oak a valuable resource for natural medicine.
